record.label: Dense reverse is not automatically uneconomic
record.summary: At the measured f32 co-fire rate, ten or twenty products can be cheaper than their nominal cap-49 count when the feature carries chain-scale raw value. Economics therefore follows, rather than replaces, the raw Schur test.
